title: Tensor and composition coherence of ringed-topos projection maps
statement:
Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be morphisms of ringed topoi presented by sites small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaves of commutative rings. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], their canonical derived adjunctions, tensor pullback comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and direct-image composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. For $h=f,g,gf$, define
$$\pi_{h,E,Q}:Rh_*E\otimes^L Q\longrightarrow Rh_*(E\otimes^L Lh^*Q)$$
as the adjunct of $\varepsilon_{h,E}\otimes1$ after the pullback tensor comparison, where $\varepsilon_h$ is the canonical counit. These projection maps are natural in both arguments, are the identity for $h=\mathrm{id}$, and obey the following two coherence identities, with all associators and canonical pullback/direct-image comparisons understood:
$$\pi_{f,E,Q\otimes^L T}=\pi_{f,E\otimes^L Lf^*Q,T}\circ(\pi_{f,E,Q}\otimes1_T)$$
for $E\in D(X)$, $Q,T\in D(Y)$, and
$$\pi_{gf,E,Q}=Rg_*(\pi_{f,E,Lg^*Q})\circ\pi_{g,Rf_*E,Q}$$
for $E\in D(X)$, $Q\in D(Z)$. In the first identity the target is $Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*Q\otimes^L Lf^*T)$; in the second it is $Rg_*Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*Lg^*Q)$.

In particular let $i:X\to W$ and $p:W\to X$ be morphisms of ringed topoi with a specified isomorphism $pi\cong\mathrm{id}_X$. Under $Rp_*Ri_*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $Li^*Lp^*\cong\mathrm{id}$, the composite
$$ M\otimes^L V\cong M\otimes^L Rp_*Ri_*V\xrightarrow{\pi_p}Rp_*(Lp^*M\otimes^L Ri_*V)\xrightarrow{Rp_*\pi_i}Rp_*Ri_*(M\otimes^L V)\cong M\otimes^L V$$
is the identity for arbitrary $M,V\in D(X)$; the displayed projection arrows use tensor symmetry to order factors as written. No projection isomorphism or boundedness assumption is needed for these equalities.
